metadata.processProtocol: Install frozen APK; speed AOT; separate shell am force-stop and am start -W calls for each later block; initial block already freshly launched. Each capture resets and settles for one second; no additional two-second launch wait was used.
metadata.traceBasename: {variant}-{workload}-{run}.perfetto-trace inside each raw block; staging adds seaglass- prefix.
metadata.timing: No host analysis/build work during capture. Counting separate and last in each first variant block.

optionalColdProtocol.protocol: Install and speed AOT each capture; force-stop; start six-second trace; am start -W; sleep six seconds; snapshots.
optionalColdProtocol.validation: Separate protocol; main block completion validation does not assert cold captures exist.
optionalColdProtocol.limitation: Fresh app process; shader-driver and filesystem caches may be warm.

session.hostElapsedSource: Reported by root capturing agent; excludes emulator startup.

visualComparison.scope: Baseline vs performance reset screenshots; crop excludes system bars.

notes: Main comparisons include only the explicitly requested variant/tumble/run labels. Warmups, idle observations and enabled deprecated allocation-counting runs are excluded from main frame/CPU summaries.
ART getRuntimeStats deltas are approximate whole-process allocation/GC counters. Bytes include Compose/framework/background work and snapshot observer overhead, not just SeaGlass.
Main snapshots require allocationCountingRequested=false; separate count snapshots require true. Unsupported/null runtime keys remain unavailable, not zero.
Idle observation bytes/CPU/GC are retained as measured per-variant diagnostics; no old idle number is assumed and no overhead is silently subtracted.

Per-build ratios divide whole-process totals by observed completed Geometry slices across the full capture, including worker and UI builds. This adjusts work-count differences but is not isolated-kernel allocation measurement. Zero builds produce null ratios.

Requests, geometry builds, uploads, Applied markers and matched presentations are separate populations. Final cohorts must have the expected surface count and presentation matches; warnings flag incompleteness.
The primary trace window is first DOWN through final UP+1000ms. Runtime endpoints span a somewhat wider interval. Scheduler residency and Process.getElapsedCpuTime differ in scope/accounting.
Stage scheduled time intersects the slice with its own thread running intervals. Wall time includes descheduling. Inclusive parent/child GC/driver durations must not be summed.
ART cumulative GC count/time, observed Perfetto GC slices and heap counter samples are distinct evidence. A smaller heap gauge or fewer samples does not establish fewer allocations/collections.
Heap-used/total/native allocator gauges and PSS are history/GC-dependent snapshots, not retained object graphs. No retained-size/leak claim follows from them alone.

Legacy object/byte counts are supplementary approximate API counters from separate runs. Any zero legacy GC delta must be compared with ART before interpretation. Do not substitute a missing ART object count with zero.

GPU observability is recorded per capture. CPU shader/flush and texture preparation do not establish GPU execution time. Emulator results do not establish physical-device, power, thermal or iOS performance.
captureProtocolNote: Prepared documentation mentioned an additional two-second launch wait. The executed loop did not use that wait; it used am start followed by the capture helper, which resets and settles for one second. Metadata was corrected to the executed protocol; metric values are unchanged.

rawEvidence.omitted: Detailed timed runtime snapshots with repeated trace stage/GPU metadata are retained in the local source. Summary, per-run metrics, separate diagnostics, notes and gestures are unchanged.
